text: The older leaders of a town. They sat by the city gate to hear disputes, give judgments, and discuss the town's affairs.
Bringing a dispute before officials or a court to receive a judgment.
'The Lord' stands for the name of Israel's God, written with four Hebrew letters. The Jews held it so holy that they did not say it aloud.
Reverent awe toward God: fearing him while honoring and serving him. Proverbs names it as the starting point of wisdom.
Words that correct what is wrong and teach the right way.
In Proverbs, not someone lacking intelligence, but someone who ignores teaching and lives by his own stubborn will.
Words that point out a wrong so it can be set right.
The insight that sees into how things work and tells right from wrong. In Proverbs it goes hand in hand with wisdom.
A field where grapevines are planted and tended, at the heart of farming in Israel.
Being so poor that life is a hard struggle.
Having run out of everything, left in great need and worn out.
Pieces of stone or metal used on scales to weigh goods. Some merchants cheated with two sets of weights that differed.
Goodwill and kindness received from others: being thought well of by God and by people.
True-hearted and constant, and so worthy of trust.
A window made of thin strips of wood woven together. You can see out through it, but it is hard to see in.
The place where animals such as cattle and pigs are killed.
Luring someone onto the wrong path and clouding their judgment.
The very first place from which something comes forth.
A large, fragrant tree that grows in Lebanon. Its wood is hard and does not rot, so Solomon built the temple and palace with it.
People who keep watch over a city gate, wall, or palace.
Channels of water dammed and led off to water fields. Just as people guide water, God guides the king's heart.
Like the troops at the very front of an army: when pride comes, ruin soon follows.
So poor that one lacks enough to eat and live on.
The wise man whose words make up Proverbs 30. Nothing is known about him except that he was the son of Jakeh.
A deep red. Scarlet clothes were thick garments dyed with costly dye, and they kept out the cold.
A woman who is kind, wise, and upright in her conduct. Proverbs 31 sings of such a woman.
Steadfast love and faithfulness, translating the Hebrew word 'hesed'.
Mixing wine with water or spices to serve at a feast, a sign that the table was prepared with care.
A name for God, meaning the one who is set apart and untouched by sin.
A person who lives rightly before God.
